services.title: Bridal Makeup
services.shortSummary: HD, Airbrush & Traditional bridal makeup with premium products.
services.fullDescription: Your wedding day is one of the most important days of your life. Our expert bridal makeup artists specialize in creating timeless, flawless looks using premium international products like MAC, Huda Beauty, and Kryolan.

services.title: Hair Styling
services.shortSummary: Bridal buns, curls, party hairstyles and elegant styling.
services.fullDescription: From elegant bridal buns to modern Hollywood waves, our hairstylists craft the perfect look to complement your features and outfit. We also offer advanced hair treatments.

services.title: Mehendi
services.shortSummary: Beautiful bridal and festive mehendi designs.
services.fullDescription: Embrace tradition with our intricate and beautiful mehendi designs. We use 100% natural, organic henna that guarantees a rich, dark stain for your big day.

services.title: Spa Therapy
services.shortSummary: Relax your body and refresh your mind with luxury spa treatments.
services.fullDescription: Escape the stress of daily life. Our luxurious spa treatments are designed to rejuvenate your mind, body, and soul using premium essential oils and ancient massage techniques.

services.title: Facial
services.shortSummary: Premium skin care treatments for glowing skin.
services.fullDescription: Experience a radiant glow with our customized facial treatments. We analyze your skin type and use dermatologically tested products to address acne, pigmentation, and anti-aging.

services.title: Nail Art
services.shortSummary: Modern nail designs crafted with precision.
services.fullDescription: Make a statement with perfectly manicured nails. From classic French tips to extravagant 3D nail art and durable acrylic extensions, our nail technicians do it all.

story.title:
Creating Beautiful
Brides Since 2010
story.text: Welcome to Ishika Professional Salon & Spa, Ghatsila's premier destination for luxury beauty services. Founded over 14 years ago, our salon has built a reputation for excellence, creativity, and unparalleled customer service. Our team of certified professionals is passionate about beauty. We specialize in HD and airbrush bridal makeup, creative hair styling, and rejuvenating spa therapies. We believe that every client is unique, and we tailor our services to highlight your individual features and personal style.

founder.name: Ishika
founder.bio: With 15 years of experience in the beauty and bridal industry, Ishika has transformed countless brides. Her passion for perfection and continuous learning ensures that every client leaves feeling like royalty.

team.title: Our Talented Team
team.text: Meet the dedicated professionals who bring the Ishika vision to life. Our team consists of highly trained makeup artists, hair stylists, and spa therapists who are passionate about their craft. With years of collective experience, we work together to ensure that every client receives personalized attention and a flawless luxury experience.

about.mission: To provide exceptional beauty services that empower our clients to feel confident and beautiful. We strive to create a relaxing, luxurious environment where every detail is taken care of.
about.vision: To be the leading luxury salon and spa in the region, constantly innovating and setting new standards in the beauty industry through continuous education and passion.

anniversary.title: 15 Years of Excellence
anniversary.text: What started as a dream has now blossomed into a legacy. We recently celebrated our 15th anniversary and inaugurated our newly upgraded salon space to provide an even more luxurious experience for our beloved clients.
